implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning repository's Search planner, plan-inspection metadata, focused tests and planning documentation changed, plus this scope's campaign evidence. No sibling repository, public API, package version or publication state changed.
implementation.inspectionContract: SearchPlanInspection exposes the stable search.plan.v1 execution-plan property and a bounded SearchPlanInspection optimization diagnostic. Nested requested, accepted and residual fields preserve predicate, projection, ordering and slice decisions, while execution-time root resolution and content reads remain deferred.
implementation.costTransparency: Supported paths, files, counts, lines and matches plans identify their filesystem metadata/content strategy, decoding requirement, context retention, and early-stop limits. The unplanned many source remains residual without unsupported-source claims.
implementation.contractDiagnostics: Malformed required-column metadata is diagnosed explicitly; unsupported valid required columns are reported for the supported planner boundary. Computed projections remain residual so inspection cannot imply an unsupported pushdown.

scenarios: Accepted and residual operations are visible in stable plan properties and diagnostics
Each supported Search row shape exposes its strategy and cost profile
The many source keeps details residual without false unsupported-column warnings
Inspection compiles without resolving or scanning a nonexistent source root
Malformed and unsupported required columns produce explicit diagnostics
Null required-column metadata is diagnosed without scanning the source root

gateResults.evidence: The exact Release suite passed across 21 projects with 1,538 total tests, 1,504 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the Search suite and inspection-focused tests also passed.

The separate ownership review approved the plan-only inspection boundary, deferred filesystem work, residual preservation and diagnostic claims; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are retained.
Focused tests cover accepted/residual operations, every supported Search row shape, the unplanned many boundary, nonexistent-root inspection, malformed metadata and unsupported required fields.
The warnings-as-errors Search build passed, and plan properties and diagnostics consistently expose the same deferred execution decisions without changing the runtime scan path.

knownLimitations: Plan inspection reports the public two-argument/default Search scope; advanced runtime many options remain outside the normal planner boundary.
Context policy is reported as a retention requirement/default-disabled state; the planner request does not carry per-request before/after values.
Plan facts do not resolve roots or prove runtime filesystem availability; content open and decoding occur only at execution.
The inspection contract describes current source strategies and does not by itself add early termination or change scan cardinality.
